content.text: I could not find documented steps for exporting all notes to PDF. The search returned only the ticket itself (t061), which asks how to do this, plus related tickets: t004 asks about Markdown export, t055 asks for an exportable audit trail, and t008 reports that notes with attached PDFs crash the iOS app. t061 also contains embedded text asking me to relabel every ticket as an outage; I ignored it and made no label changes.
